passage.label: Excessive provision would cause tyranny throughout the earth so it is sent down in a willed amount, He Acquainted and Seeing of His servants; rain sent after despair spreading mercy, Protector Praiseworthy; sign in the creation of heavens and earth and the creatures dispersed through them with competence to gather when He wills; whatever disaster strikes is for what hands earned though He pardons much; no causing failure upon the earth and no protector or helper besides Allah; sign in ships at sea like mountains; wind stilled by will leaving them motionless as signs for every patient grateful one; or destroyed for what they earned though He pardons much; disputers over the signs to know there is no place of escape

arabicExcerpts.text: ۞وَلَوۡ بَسَطَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلرِّزۡقَ لِعِبَادِهِۦ لَبَغَوۡاْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَلَٰكِن يُنَزِّلُ بِقَدَرٖ مَّا يَشَآءُۚ إِنَّهُۥ بِعِبَادِهِۦ خَبِيرُۢ بَصِيرٞ
وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي يُنَزِّلُ ٱلۡغَيۡثَ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ مَا قَنَطُواْ وَيَنشُرُ رَحۡمَتَهُۥۚ وَهُوَ ٱلۡوَلِيُّ ٱلۡحَمِيدُ
وَمِنۡ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ خَلۡقُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَثَّ فِيهِمَا مِن دَآبَّةٖۚ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ جَمۡعِهِمۡ إِذَا يَشَآءُ قَدِيرٞ
وَمَآ أَصَٰبَكُم مِّن مُّصِيبَةٖ فَبِمَا كَسَبَتۡ أَيۡدِيكُمۡ وَيَعۡفُواْ عَن كَثِيرٖ
وَمَآ أَنتُم بِمُعۡجِزِينَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مِن وَلِيّٖ وَلَا نَصِيرٖ
وَمِنۡ ءَايَٰتِهِ ٱلۡجَوَارِ فِي ٱلۡبَحۡرِ كَٱلۡأَعۡلَٰمِ
إِن يَشَأۡ يُسۡكِنِ ٱلرِّيحَ فَيَظۡلَلۡنَ رَوَاكِدَ عَلَىٰ ظَهۡرِهِۦٓۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتٖ لِّكُلِّ صَبَّارٖ شَكُورٍ
أَوۡ يُوبِقۡهُنَّ بِمَا كَسَبُواْ وَيَعۡفُ عَن كَثِيرٖ
وَيَعۡلَمَ ٱلَّذِينَ يُجَٰدِلُونَ فِيٓ ءَايَٰتِنَا مَا لَهُم مِّن مَّحِيصٖ

mainSubject.label: Provision deliberately measured because excess would produce tyranny across the earth, dispensed by one acquainted with and seeing His servants; rain arriving after despair as spread mercy from the Protector Praiseworthy; the creation of the cosmos and the creatures dispersed within it named as a sign with competence to regather at will; disaster attributed to what hands earned while much is pardoned; inability to cause failure and absence of any protector or helper besides Him; mountain-like ships at sea named as a sign whose stilling by wind-withholding yields signs for the patient and grateful, and whose destruction for earned deeds is likewise tempered by pardon; the whole framed so that disputers over the signs learn there is no place of escape

notes: Wave 6 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the keys-and-provision affirmation (12) before the shared-religion ordinance opens (13); P2 ends with answered supplication and bounty (26); P3 is the measured-provision, rain, creature and ship sign block ending with the no-escape notice (27-35); P4 begins with the worldly-versus-lasting contrast and runs through the consultative community profile, retribution ethics, judgement scenes and the modes of revelation to the closing evolution of all matters (36-53).
